attributes.name: Treacherous Teleport
attributes.powers: On your turn, discard this card to move, then examine your location deck until you find a monster and encounter it; banish any boons you examined. For your combat check, use your Strength, Melee, or Arcane skill + 2d12.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have the Arcane skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at an Arcane 15 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
